expandCandidates.comment: Candidate expand/collapse a11y label; bidirectional wording covers both states. Android: smartbar strip chevron + overlay collapse via stringRes. iOS: CandidateSuggestionsRow strip chevron + ExpandedCandidateOverlay collapse via DisplayLanguageStore.

values.hanji: 展開抑是收合候選詞列
values.tailo: Tián-khui ah-sī siu-ha̍p hāu-suán sû lia̍t
values.poj: Tián-khui ah-sī siu-ha̍p hāu-soán sû lia̍t
values.en: Expand or collapse the candidate list
values.ja: 候補リストを展開または折りたたむ

morePopupHint.comment: Key-preview popup three-dots-indicator a11y contentDescription (long-press reveals more glyphs). Android extension popup only.

values.ja: 長押しでさらに文字を入力できます

toggleToolbar.comment: Smartbar toolbar-toggle button a11y label (the +-icon expands/collapses the toolbar row); bidirectional wording. Android via InputView.applyAccessibilityStrings; iOS via DisplayLanguageStore in ToolShortcutsToolbar.

values.ja: ツールバーを展開または折りたたむ

symbolPanel.comment: Smartbar toolbar symbol-panel button a11y label (opens the symbol/punctuation panel). Android applies it via InputView.applyAccessibilityStrings; iOS via DisplayLanguageStore in ToolShortcutsToolbar.

switchLayout.comment: Smartbar toolbar layout-switch button a11y label (opens the keyboard-layout selector). Android via InputView.applyAccessibilityStrings; iOS via DisplayLanguageStore in ToolShortcutsToolbar.

values.ja: レイアウトを切り替え

switchInputMethod.comment: Smartbar toolbar globe button a11y label (opens the system input-method picker). Android via InputView.applyAccessibilityStrings; iOS via DisplayLanguageStore in ToolShortcutsToolbar.

switchInputMethodHint.comment: Globe / next-keyboard button a11y HINT conveying the non-obvious long-press affordance (the tap action is announced automatically by VoiceOver, so the hint only adds the long-press behaviour). iOS-only: Android has no accessibilityHint equivalent (it folds operation hints into contentDescription). TL/POJ DRAFT — pending USER proofread.

values.ja: 長押しでキーボードを選択

dismissKeyboard.comment: Smartbar toolbar dismiss button a11y label (hides the keyboard). Android via InputView.applyAccessibilityStrings; iOS via DisplayLanguageStore in ToolShortcutsToolbar.

oneHandedMode.comment: Name of the one-handed mode callout opened by long-pressing the toolbar keyboard button; also its a11y long-press action name. TL/POJ from the bundled dictionary (單手 tuann-tshiú) + 輸入模式 spelling.

oneHandedLeft.comment: One-handed mode callout item: keys dock to the left edge. TL/POJ from the bundled dictionary (倒手 tò-tshiú).

oneHandedRight.comment: One-handed mode callout item: keys dock to the right edge. TL/POJ from the bundled dictionary (正手 tsiànn-tshiú).

oneHandedOff.comment: One-handed mode callout item and side-panel button: back to the full-width keyboard. TL/POJ from the bundled dictionary (一般 it-puann).

oneHandedSwapSide.comment: One-handed mode side-panel button a11y label: move the docked keys to the other edge. TL/POJ from the bundled dictionary (換爿 uānn-pîng).
